name: Dusty Duel

features.name: Wild or Dead duels
features.description: VS reels become fully wild or completely empty.

features.name: Several bonus routes
features.description: Scatters, Chance 300% or three buy options.

review:
A western pay-anywhere game with a sharpshooting heroine and a brilliant duel mechanic. VS symbols expand over a reel and fight it out: if Wild wins, the whole reel goes wild until the refill ends; if Dead wins, the reel empties and sits out the rest of the spin.

Collect multiplier bullets from the reels to boost wins, and reach the bonus through scatters, a Chance 300% option or three buy choices. Every expansion is a little moment of tension. Medium-high volatility, 5,000x max, 97% RTP.
pros: Excellent 97.00% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
